description: Checks the meeting brief: Stand greets the people it names, leaves out what it says to leave out, and answers from it. Run with --brief poc/heckler/brief.md.

during.label: price, which the brief covers
during.say: Sorry, before you go on. How much would this cost us?

after.label: pilot date, from the brief
after.say: If we wanted to try it, when could a pilot start?

after.label: the part it was told to leave out
after.say: By the way, where does the name Stand come from?

after.label: something nobody told it
after.say: How many people are on your engineering team?
